name: symulate-k6-load-tests
description: Production-oriented Symulate AI k6 and Playwright validation suite with deterministic CSV-backed candidate provisioning, invitation-gated activity execution, backend-compatible project activation checks, isolated per-VU projects, Welcome-stage composition, pre-provisioned smoke coverage, Anam resilience validation, and optional Grafana/InfluxDB monitoring.

scripts.load:situation:no-anum: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only ANUM_API_ENABLED=false
scripts.load:all: npm run load && npm run load:no-anum && npm run load:situation && npm run load:situation:no-anum
scripts.load:candidate: node scripts/run.js tests/load-candidate-assessment.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=full LOAD_VUS=1
scripts.load:candidate:situation: node scripts/run.js tests/load-candidate-assessment.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only LOAD_VUS=1
scripts.review: node scripts/run.js tests/load-project-review.js LOAD_MODE=smoke SCENARIO=full LOAD_VUS=1
scripts.review:grafana: node scripts/run.js tests/load-project-review.js LOAD_MODE=smoke SCENARIO=full LOAD_VUS=1 K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
scripts.load:review: node scripts/run.js tests/load-project-review.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=full LOAD_VUS=1
scripts.load:grafana: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
scripts.load:grafana:no-anum: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load ANUM_API_ENABLED=false K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
scripts.load:grafana:situation: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=situation-only K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
scripts.load:10: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load LOAD_VUS=10 LOAD_ITERATIONS_PER_VU=1
scripts.load:client-project:10: node scripts/run.js tests/load-client-project.js LOAD_MODE=load SCENARIO=full LOAD_VUS=10 LOAD_ITERATIONS_PER_VU=1
scripts.validate:e2e-runner: cross-env SEND_PROJECT_INVITATIONS=true ANAM_MODE=outage503 E2E_RUNNER_DRY_RUN=true node scripts/e2e-no-anum-full.js
scripts.load:no-anum:grafana: node scripts/run.js tests/smoke.js LOAD_MODE=load ANUM_API_ENABLED=false K6_INFLUXDB_PUSH_INTERVAL=3s --out influxdb=http://localhost:8087/k6
